description: Golden oracle for issue 6.3 (device discovery). The expected typed Device parsed from the recorded, de-identified AiM MyChron discovery response (see docs/device/PROTOCOL.md §2). address is decoded from the response body (offset 0x08); port is the control/transfer port we connect to next (CONTROL_PORT 2000 — the response's own port field at 0x0C is uncertain); model is the MyChron family selected by the response type tag (2); name is a deterministic display name derived from model + address (the unit's advertised name/serial are de-identified out of the committed fixture, and on the live mDNS path come from the Bonjour service metadata).
